summary: Exhaustive Q4 walk over instruction.md, all /docs contracts, and tests/test_outputs.py finds strong coverage for revision/idempotency authority, canonical digests, quorum rollout, TCP streaming/selection, eligibility (zone/fail-open/drain/passive), readiness, audit bounds, and dataplane checkpoint recovery. Bidirectional alignment still fails: graded management HTTP status codes and GET /metrics are not in the solver-visible contract, and material instruction requirements for active health, control-frame fencing/torn-frame non-advancement, control-plane restart recovery, and connect/idle/backpressure stream semantics lack meaningful tests.

evidence.observation: Exactly 20 concise bullets state the full work package: workspace/binaries, validation, revision/idempotency fences, immutable digests, control protocol envelopes, node fencing, quorum rollout, persistence/recovery, TCP proxy semantics, generation binding, selection policies, eligibility combination including active health and passive ejection, drain, PROXY v2, checkpoint recovery without torn-frame authority advance, bounded observability, 24-node lab inventory, exclusions, and docs/idempotency closure.

Documents readiness JSON semantics, GET /v1/status (including rollout_present), GET /v1/audit event shape and forbidden fields, and metrics label cardinality rules. Does not name GET /metrics or HTTP status codes for apply/readiness failures.

Defines length-prefixed canonical JSON, hello/prepare/prepared/rejected/activate/active/status envelopes, sequence/session fencing, and torn-frame no-effect rule. No verifier probes inject torn frames or fencing conflicts.

Eligibility explicitly combines administrative state, draining, active health, passive ejection, and zone policy; active probes publish bounded health transitions. Passive ejection is tested; active-health failure paths are not.

Requires authority.json accepted_revision/accepted_digest restore before mutations, padded generation directories, CURRENT fallback, idempotency record restore, and node session fence persistence across reconnect.

Operator entrypoints under /app/sovereign-lb/bin/*, management vs control listeners, apply requiring revision and idempotency key. Mentions inspecting readiness and metrics without HTTP paths or status codes.
Public CLI maps status/nodes/audit to /v1/* and ready to /ready; no metrics command. Idempotency-Key header is discoverable here.

37 probes: 4 P2P and 33 F2P covering authority, canonical validation/digest, rollout/quorum/audit, TCP/selection/PROXY echo, readiness, unknown apply fields, metrics generation= bound, eligibility (zone/fail-open/incarnation/drain/passive), and dataplane checkpoint padding/restart/CURRENT fallback. Hard-asserts HTTP 422/409/400 and GET /metrics; no active-health, control-plane restart, or torn-frame/session-fence rejection probes.
Classification-only map aligns test names to P2P/F2P and REQ_* families; used solely to confirm boundary labels, not as requirement authority.

Q4 requires complete forward/reverse matrices, instruction completeness and docs-boundary walks, F2P/P2P and output-interface inspection, second omission sweep, and REVISE on any material phantom, untested requirement, or grading-relevant ambiguity.

Instruction owns material functional ask; docs may hold protocol/schema/API contracts but must not hide goals; grading-relevant schemas must remain discoverable; Q4 certifies bidirectional alignment after freeze.

findings.criterion: Every substantive verifier behavior maps to a discoverable solver-visible requirement (no phantom return-value contracts)
findings.why_it_matters: Verifier hard-requires HTTP 422 for invalid desired documents, 409 for stale/conflicting revision or idempotency reuse, and 400 for unknown apply fields. Instruction and docs only say reject/conflict/invalid; no solver-visible management API contract states those status codes. Competent implementations using alternate 4xx mapping fail despite satisfying stated rejection semantics.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add a management HTTP contract (new docs page or operations/observability section) stating apply status codes: 422 validation, 409 revision/idempotency conflict, 400 malformed/unknown fields (and success 200/202 if graded), then keep the existing asserts.
findings.regression_risk: Low for documentation; existing tests already encode the intended codes.

findings.criterion: Graded output/interface paths are discoverable from the solver-visible contract
findings.why_it_matters: test_f2p_metrics_labels_bounded grades GET /metrics text exposition and generation= label cardinality. Observability documents metric semantics and forbids generation as a label but never names the /metrics path; lbctl has no metrics command (unlike /ready). A solver exposing equivalent metrics under /v1/metrics or another documented-style path fails the probe.
findings.minimal_remediation: Document GET /metrics (content-type/text exposition and forbidden high-cardinality labels including generation) in observability.md or operations.md; optionally add lbctl metrics for operator discoverability.
findings.regression_risk: Low for path documentation; tighten label rule to zero generation labels if aligning fully with observability prose.

findings.criterion: Every material solver-visible requirement has meaningful behavioral test coverage (forward matrix)
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires combining administrative state, active health, passive ejection, zone policy, fail-open, and draining exactly as documented. Eligibility F2P covers zone, fail-open/disabled, drain, incarnation, and passive ejection, but never drives active-probe unhealthy/healthy thresholds. A solver can stub active health as always-healthy and still pass.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add an F2P that makes a target fail active health (send/expect or connect probe) with fail_open false and asserts it is skipped, then recovers after healthy_threshold successes if that recovery is graded.
findings.regression_risk: Moderate timing risk; pin probe intervals/thresholds and use deterministic lab backends.

findings.criterion: Material fencing and torn-frame safety requirements are behaviorally tested
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction and control-protocol require node/session/generation/digest/sequence fencing and that torn or invalid control frames must not advance authority. Verifier only exercises happy-path prepare/activate (and dataplane restart). Sequence reuse with different content, stale session, or partial-frame injection is untested, so fencing defects can ship green.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add focused control-channel probes: inject a torn length-prefix/body and assert no generation/authority advance; inject sequence or session mismatch and assert rejection without quorum/authority progress.
findings.regression_risk: Moderate harness complexity; keep probes independent of existing rollout happy-path tests.

findings.criterion: Material persist-and-recover obligations for control-plane authority are tested
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires atomic persist/recover of desired state, generations, rollout, idempotency records, and node fences. recovery.md requires restoring accepted_revision/accepted_digest and idempotency before mutations. Tests persist accepted_digest on apply and recover dataplane checkpoints, but never restart the control plane and verify revision/idempotency fences survive. Control-plane recovery bugs remain invisible.
findings.minimal_remediation: After a successful apply, restart lb-control-plane on the same state root and assert accepted_revision/digest, idempotent replay, and stale-revision conflict still hold before mutations.
findings.regression_risk: Low if state roots are already isolated per test.

findings.criterion: Material stream operational requirements named in the work request are tested
findings.why_it_matters: The stream bullet requires bounded buffers, partial I/O, backpressure, half-close, connect timeout, idle timeout, and deterministic teardown. Verifier covers large multibuffer echo and half-close only. Connect timeout, idle timeout, and EPOLLIN backpressure when the peer buffer is full are untested; solvers can omit them and still score 1. This changes external observable correctness for documented stable dataplane behavior, so MEDIUM is blocking.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add at least one connect-timeout failure probe and one idle-timeout or full-buffer backpressure probe against lab slow/reset backends with pinned timeouts.
findings.regression_risk: Moderate flakiness if timeouts are tight; use generous bounds and lab slow reader.

findings.criterion: Preservation of the documented 24-node inventory is meaningfully asserted
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires keeping the deterministic 24-node, three-zone inventory. P2P only asserts fleet.json exists, not node count or zone distribution, so a truncated inventory file would still pass.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: assert len(nodes)==24 and three zones in fleet.json during P2P catalog checks.

findings.criterion: PROXY v2 at-most-once and reconnect header reset coverage depth
findings.why_it_matters: proxy-inspect echo implies at least one valid PROXY v2 header reached the inspector. At-most-once on a single backend and header reset on reconnect are not separately asserted.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: assert lab inspector event count/header fields and a reconnect path that expects a fresh single header.

findings.criterion: Binary output path wording vs build layout clarity
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction names artifacts under /app/sovereign-lb/bin/*; bin/build writes to build/bin and wrappers exec those artifacts; tests assert build/bin presence. Discoverable but slightly asymmetric for solvers who only read the instruction path list.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: one operations sentence that bin/* wrappers invoke build/bin artifacts produced by bin/build.

next_gate: SPEC_ALIGNMENT (Q1 management HTTP contract; Q2 untested active-health/fencing/CP-recovery/stream probes)

role_output.P2P_BOUNDARY_NOTES: P2P probes preserve shipped binaries/catalog and already-working validation/idempotency/lbctl surfaces; no circular oracle or external-network bypass observed.
role_output.F2P_BOUNDARY_NOTES: F2P probes own behavioral gaps (authority, rollout, stream, eligibility, recovery). Passive of passive-ejection then echo-only apply still meaningfully asserts ejection before cutover. Quorum test uses wall-clock wait without asserting durable rejected/aborted phase explicitly.
role_output.SECOND_OMISSION_SWEEP_NOTES: Second pass rechecked SHALL/MUST in docs for management HTTP codes, /metrics path, active probes, torn frames, control-plane authority restore, connect/idle/backpressure, generation-number reuse after failed rollout, and retention-referenced generations; first four clusters remain material gaps (findings above). Generation-number non-reuse and retention accounting remain untested but are narrower durability edges treated as advisory residual rather than additional blockers given existing preserve-active and checkpoint coverage.
